crossRefs.note: They who render evil for good are also adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.
They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.
Jonathan spoke good of David to Saul his father, and said to him, “Don’t let the king sin against his servant, against…
for he put his life in his hand, and struck the Philistine, and Yahweh worked a great victory for all Israel. You saw…
Saul sent the messengers to see David, saying, “Bring him up to me in the bed, that I may kill him.”
Saul said to him, “Why have you conspired against me, you and the son of Jesse, in that you have given him bread, and a…
Then Ahimelech answered the king, and said, “Who among all your servants is so faithful as David, who is the king’s…
Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
Should evil be recompensed for good? For they have dug a pit for my soul. Remember how I stood before you to speak good…
Jesus answered them, “I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?”
For as long as the son of Jesse lives on the earth, you will not be established, nor will your kingdom. Therefore now…
but they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify him!”
